sourceItems.title: 华北液化天然气价格暴涨 发改委价监局要求市场主体自律
normalizedClaims: North China LNG delivered prices had risen roughly RMB3,000-4,000/t over about three months and roughly doubled.
NDRC price-supervision authorities convened major producers, import terminals, storage/sales firms and local regulators to restrain abnormal winter price volatility.
observedChanges: winter gas shortage is already producing extreme spot-price stress and policy intervention

sourceItems.title: 关于加大清洁煤供应确保群众温暖过冬的通知
sourceItems.publisher: 国家发展改革委/国家能源局
normalizedClaims: Official policy acknowledged structural, seasonal and regional natural-gas supply-demand imbalances during the winter heating peak.
Authorities increased clean-coal supply as an emergency substitute to relieve heating pressure.
observedChanges: gas scarcity is real but government substitution/intervention can shorten the price shock

sourceItems.title: 关于公开征求《进口废纸环境保护管理规定（征求意见稿）》意见的通知
normalizedClaims: MEP proposed tighter environmental management for imported waste paper and higher scale requirements for importing/processing enterprises.
The rule implemented the broader foreign-waste import reform and could change imported-fiber access across mills.
observedChanges: regulatory access to imported recycled fiber is tightening and may become scale/compliance dependent

sourceItems.title: 双十一过后废纸价格整体回调30% 料维持上涨态势
normalizedClaims: Domestic waste-paper prices had corrected about 30% after the Double-11 recovery peak but many mills were again raising purchase prices.
Industry participants expected tighter import policy and year-end demand to keep waste-paper prices elevated.
observedChanges: raw-material price is volatile and already elevated, so import restriction is not automatically positive for every mill

sourceItems.title: 关于发布《进口废纸环境保护管理规定》的公告
normalizedClaims: MEP formally issued the imported-waste-paper environmental management regulation, effective immediately.
The rule made the earlier regulatory tightening concrete before year-end.
observedChanges: imported recycled-fiber access changes from proposal to implemented rule

sourceItems.title: 2017年11月销售挖掘机13822台，同比涨107.4%
sourceItems.publisher: 中国路面机械网/中国工程机械工业协会挖掘机械分会
normalizedClaims: November excavator sales were 13,822 units, +107.4% YoY; Jan-Nov sales were 126,298, +99.2% YoY.
Domestic sales rose 117.2% YoY in November and exports rose 27.3%.
observedChanges: equipment physical demand remains exceptionally strong late in the year

sourceItems.title: 11月挖掘机数据发布，三一销量稳居榜首
normalizedClaims: Sany sold 3,099 excavators in November, +118.86% YoY, with about 22.42% monthly market share.
Sany's share exceeded the combined share of the second- and third-ranked brands in the cited data.
observedChanges: leader share strengthens inside an already-booming machinery cycle

sourceItems.title: Mobile DRAM Prices to Go Up by 10~15% in 4Q17
normalizedClaims: TrendForce expected 4Q17 mobile DRAM prices to rise 10-15% QoQ.
Large-scale new DRAM capacity was unlikely in 2018 and server/datacenter demand was rising, supporting continued tight supply.
observedChanges: DRAM supply remains structurally tight but downstream prices are already rising

sourceItems.title: TrendForce Reports 3Q17 DRAM Revenue Hit a New High
normalizedClaims: Global DRAM industry revenue reached a new high in 3Q17, +16.2% QoQ.
4Q17 DRAM prices were expected to rise about 10% on average as supply stayed tight.
observedChanges: product tightness has already converted into record industry revenue and higher contract pricing

sourceItems.title: 国家发展改革委制定2018年光伏发电价格政策促进产业健康可持续发展
normalizedClaims: For projects commissioned after 2018-01-01, benchmark PV tariffs were cut RMB0.10/kWh across resource regions.
Distributed self-consumption subsidy was reduced by RMB0.05/kWh to RMB0.37/kWh, while poverty-alleviation PV tariffs/subsidies were preserved.
observedChanges: 2018 project economics face a known subsidy/tariff step-down, partly justified by rapid cost declines

sourceItems.title: 唐山钢铁限产提前至10月12日 建筑工地停工
normalizedClaims: Tangshan advanced steel winter-curtailment measures to October 12 and required 50% shutdown of sintering/pelletizing equipment until detailed plans applied.
Construction earthworks were also halted through the winter period, creating both steel-supply and end-demand effects.
observedChanges: environmental policy creates a simultaneous supply restriction and demand offset

sourceItems.title: 北方限产不抵淡季需求热情 钢铁PMI连续7月处扩张区间
normalizedClaims: Tangshan's planned heating-season steel curtailment ratio was 50%, with an estimated 18.21m tons of blast-furnace iron impact over four months.
Reported Tangshan blast-furnace operating rate was about 56.82%; other provinces also joined production curbs, tightening supply.
observedChanges: physical capacity utilization is visibly constrained, but construction demand is also seasonally/policy affected

eventClusters.statement: North China entered a severe winter gas imbalance: LNG delivered prices roughly doubled while official policy acknowledged structural/seasonal/regional gas shortages and deployed substitute clean-coal supply.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Spot LNG price has already doubled, authorities are intervening, and clean coal is being deployed as a substitute; deep research must not equate a real shortage with an unpriced gas-equity opportunity.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a listed company with verified supply/access or throughput leverage whose earnings can still improve after accounting for extreme spot-price absorption and policy substitution?

eventClusters.statement: Imported-waste-paper regulation moved from draft to final implementation while domestic waste-paper and packaging-paper prices were already highly volatile and elevated, potentially redistributing raw-material access toward larger compliant mills.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Tighter import access can help compliant scale leaders relative to peers but can also raise raw-material costs for the whole industry; current paper prices have already risen substantially.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can deep research verify a relative input-access advantage at a listed mill, and does it survive company balance-sheet/capital-allocation risk under V1.7?

eventClusters.statement: Excavator demand remained extraordinarily strong late in 2017, with November sales +107.4% YoY and Sany's leader share strengthening.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The physical cycle is extremely strong but already mature after a full-year boom; deep research must search financing, receivables, dealer/channel and leverage risks as aggressively as unit-growth evidence.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Do leader earnings, cash conversion and valuation still leave a company-specific opportunity after explicit V1.7 adversarial-risk review?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM supply remained tight and contract pricing/revenue kept rising into 4Q17, with limited large-scale capacity additions expected, but the favorable product state was already visible in prices and industry revenue.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Product economics are strong but already flow-confirmed; A-share mapping must not substitute generic semiconductor names for direct DRAM supplier earnings.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any direct A-share expression with cutoff-valid earnings conversion and residual expectation room, or should the Skill fail closed?

eventClusters.statement: NDRC formally cut 2018 PV benchmark tariffs and distributed subsidy levels, creating a known step-down in project revenue while explicitly arguing that technology/cost declines could preserve project attractiveness.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The tariff cut is negative in isolation but may be offset by rapid cost decline; deep research must decompose low-cost leaders from high-cost capacity instead of treating the whole PV chain as one direction.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any listed company have a verified cost/share engine that makes the 2018 tariff step-down an opportunity rather than a demand-risk event?

eventClusters.statement: Heating-season environmental controls materially constrained northern steel operating capacity while simultaneously restricting construction activity, creating a supply-demand conflict rather than a simple steel-price bullish signal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Supply is constrained but construction itself is also restricted; company-specific geography/compliance and product mix can dominate broad steel beta.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can a listed producer show a verified relative allowed-capacity or margin advantage after decomposing demand offsets and company-specific risk?

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was RMB28.159bn, +70.8% YoY; attributable profit RMB1.803bn, +932.6%; ex-item profit RMB1.545bn versus a prior-year loss.
Operating cash flow was RMB6.880bn, +238.1% YoY, materially stronger than accounting profit.
The report showed a much stronger balance-sheet/cash-conversion profile than the prior year while the physical excavator cycle remained exceptionally strong.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工2017年三季报机构预期摘要
normalizedClaims: A contemporaneous research snapshot referenced price around RMB8.27 and 2017/2018/2019 earnings forecasts around RMB2.5bn/RMB3.0bn/RMB4.0bn.
The corresponding cited forward valuation burden was roughly mid-20s PE for 2017 and low-20s for 2018, so the boom was no longer an undiscovered deep-value setup.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山鹰纸业2017年第三季度报告与募投进度
normalizedClaims: The company was simultaneously expanding capacity and using previously raised equity funds for a large paper project, with remaining project investment requiring self-funding.
The report disclosed continuing financing/capital-allocation complexity rather than a clean single-variable raw-material-policy exposure.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山鹰纸业财务负责人收到中国证监会调查通知书
normalizedClaims: The company disclosed that its finance chief received a CSRC investigation notice for suspected securities-law violations.
The company stated the investigation was personal and did not affect normal operations, but it was a cutoff-valid governance/control risk requiring independent review.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山鹰纸业关于收购福建省联盛纸业有限责任公司100%股权的公告
normalizedClaims: The company agreed to pay RMB1.9bn cash for 100% of Liansheng Paper.
The acquisition added a large capital-allocation and financing decision directly before the cutoff while the packaging-paper cycle was already strong.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山鹰纸业关于收购联盛纸业100%股权的补充及澄清公告
normalizedClaims: Liansheng's equity book value at the valuation date was about RMB275m; asset-basis value about RMB481m and income-approach value about RMB1.604bn.
The agreed RMB1.9bn cash price therefore required a substantial earnings-based valuation premium and made acquisition execution/financing a first-order part of the equity thesis.

evidenceDocuments.title: 隆基股份2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB10.846bn, +27.2%, and attributable profit about RMB2.241bn, +104.0%; operating cash flow was strongly positive.
Receivables, inventory, fixed assets and construction-in-progress rose rapidly as the company expanded capacity.
Short-term and long-term debt rose materially and a RMB2.8bn public convertible-bond financing had been approved, making financing/capex a necessary counter-thesis.

evidenceDocuments.title: 隆基股份2017年12月中旬机构研究快照
normalizedClaims: A contemporaneous research report referenced price around RMB36.61 and estimated 2017/2018 PE around 25.7x/21.1x.
The report expected continued capacity expansion and cost leadership but explicitly listed price competition and polysilicon-cost pressure as risks.

evidenceDocuments.title: 通威股份2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue grew roughly 25%, attributable profit roughly 70%, and ex-item profit much faster.
The same period included aggressive investment, higher borrowings and rising working-capital balances, supporting the view that PV operating strength coexisted with financing/capex risk.

evidenceDocuments.title: 兆易创新2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB1.517bn, +44.7%; attributable profit about RMB339m, +134.7%; operating cash flow improved sharply.
The existing listed-company earnings engine was not direct commodity DRAM supply; therefore global DRAM tightness could not automatically be mapped into this equity.

evidenceDocuments.title: 兆易创新合肥DRAM研发合作事项
normalizedClaims: The company announced cooperation on a 19nm 12-inch memory/DRAM R&D project with a very large project budget.

The arrangement was still a future R&D/industrialization plan with execution and funding uncertainty and no material contribution to 2017 profit, so it was not a cutoff-valid direct DRAM earnings expression.

evidenceDocuments.title: 紫光国芯2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue grew but attributable profit declined year-on-year.
The earnings profile did not validate treating a generic domestic-memory/security-chip name as a direct beneficiary of global DRAM contract-price tightness.

evidenceDocuments.title: 新奥股份2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue and attributable profit rose strongly and operating cash flow improved.

At the same cutoff, one-year non-current liabilities and construction-in-progress had risen materially, so gas/LNG exposure required financing and capex scrutiny rather than a simple spot-price mapping.

evidenceDocuments.title: 广汇能源2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue and attributable profit rose strongly, but finance expense and financing-lease-related long-term payables were also high/rising.
The company offered direct energy exposure but not a clean low-risk pass-through from already-extreme LNG spot prices to incremental equity earnings.

evidenceDocuments.title: 宝钢股份2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue and attributable profit rose strongly, with attributable profit nearly doubling.
Operating cash flow improved only modestly relative to the profit expansion, while the winter-curtailment event simultaneously restricted steel supply and construction demand.

evidenceDocuments.title: 恒立液压2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB2.027bn, +109.5% YoY, and attributable profit about RMB276.3m, +572.8%, confirming exceptionally strong machinery-component operating leverage.

Receivables rose about 62.2%, short-term borrowings about 53.7%, finance expense rose sharply, and impairment loss increased as receivables grew, making working-capital/financing quality a real counter-thesis despite strong earnings.
Excavator-cylinder revenue grew about 129%, non-standard cylinder revenue about 97%, and small-excavator pump/valve production ramped, confirming direct machinery-cycle exposure.

evidenceDocuments.title: 太阳纸业2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB13.706bn, +34.4% YoY, attributable profit about RMB1.374bn, +109.1%, showing strong paper-cycle earnings conversion.
1-9M operating cash flow was about RMB1.746bn but -21.2% YoY even as profit more than doubled, so cash conversion did not improve in line with accounting earnings.
The company cited both new boxboard capacity and stronger product pricing; impairment loss also increased because of higher bad-debt provisions.

evidenceDocuments.title: 晨鸣纸业2017年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB21.929bn, +32.3% YoY, and attributable profit about RMB2.712bn, +74.5%, confirming broad paper-cycle profitability.
1-9M operating cash flow remained negative at about RMB-1.613bn despite strong reported profit, creating a material cash-conversion/financing-quality counterpoint.
The company therefore provided a useful control showing that strong sector pricing did not automatically imply equally strong cash-flow quality.
